pairs: “These things I have spoken to you,
so that you would not stumble.
They will put you out of the synagogues.
sed venit hora, ut omnis qui interficit vos arbitretur obsequium se præstare Deo.
But the hour is coming when everyone who puts you to death will consider that he is offering an excellent service to God.
Et hæc facient vobis, quia non noverunt Patrem,
And they will do these things to you because they have not known the Father,
But these things I have spoken to you, so that,
ut cum venerit hora eorum, reminiscamini quia ego dixi vobis.
when the hour for these things will have arrived, you may remember that I told you.
Hæc autem vobis ab initio non dixi,
But I did not tell you these things from the beginning,
Et nunc vado ad eum qui misit me;
And now I am going to him who sent me.
et nemo ex vobis interrogat me:
And no one among you has asked me,
sed quia hæc locutus sum vobis,
But because I have spoken these things to you,
But I tell you the truth:
it is expedient for you that I am going.
For if I do not go,
the Advocate will not come to you.
But when I will have gone away,
I will send him to you.
he will argue against the world,
et de justitia, et de judicio.
about sin and about justice and about judgment:
because they have not believed in me;
because I am going to the Father,
and you will not see me any longer;
quia princeps hujus mundi jam judicatus est.
because the prince of this world has already been judged.
I still have many things to say to you,
but you are not able to bear them now.
Cum autem venerit ille Spiritus veritatis,
But when the Spirit of truth has arrived,
he will teach the whole truth to you.
For he will not be speaking from himself.
Instead, whatever he will hear, he will speak.
et quæ ventura sunt annuntiabit vobis.
And he will announce to you the things that are to come.
For he will receive from what is mine,
and he will announce it to you.
All things whatsoever that the Father has are mine.
Propterea dixi: quia de meo accipiet, et annuntiabit vobis.
I said that he will receive from what is mine and that he will announce it to you.
and then you will not see me.
For I am going to the Father.”
Dixerunt ergo ex discipulis ejus ad invicem:
Then some of his disciples said to one another: “What is this,
Quid est hoc quod dicit nobis: Modicum,
that he is saying to us: ‘A little while,
and you will not see me,’
and, ‘For I am going to the Father?’”
that he is saying, ‘A little while?’
We do not understand what he is saying.”
But Jesus realized that they wanted to question him,
and so he said to them:
“Are you inquiring among yourselves about this,
De hoc quæritis inter vos quia dixi:
and you will not see me,
that you shall mourn and weep,
And you shall be greatly saddened,
sed tristitia vestra vertetur in gaudium.
yet your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
A woman, when she is giving birth,
tristitiam habet, quia venit hora ejus;
has sorrow, because her hour has arrived.
But when she has given birth to the child,
jam non meminit pressuræ propter gaudium,
then she no longer remembers the difficulties, because of the joy:
quia natus est homo in mundum.
for a man has been born into the world.
Et vos igitur nunc quidem tristitiam habetis,
have sorrow now. But I will see you again,
et gaudium vestrum nemo tollet a vobis.
And no one will take away your joy from you.
Et in illo die me non rogabitis quidquam.
And, in that day, you will not petition me for anything.
si quid petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, dabit vobis.
if you ask the Father for anything in my name, he will give it to you.
Usque modo non petistis quidquam in nomine meo:
Until now, you have not requested anything in my name.
so that your joy may be full.
Hæc in proverbiis locutus sum vobis.
I have spoken these things to you in proverbs.
Venit hora cum jam non in proverbiis loquar vobis,
The hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in proverbs; instead,
sed palam de Patre annuntiabo vobis:
I will announce to you plainly from the Father.
in illo die in nomine meo petetis:
In that day, you shall ask in my name,
et non dico vobis quia ego rogabo Patrem de vobis:
and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father for you.
For the Father himself loves you,
et credidistis, quia ego a Deo exivi.
and because you have believed that I went forth from God.
I went forth from the Father,
and I have come into the world.
Next I am leaving the world,
and I am going to the Father.”
now you are speaking plainly and not reciting a proverb.
Now we know that you know all things,
et non opus est tibi ut quis te interroget:
and that you have no need for anyone to question you.
in hoc credimus quia a Deo existi.
By this, we believe that you went forth from God.”
when you will be scattered, each one on his own,
and you will leave me behind, alone.
And yet I am not alone,
for the Father is with me.
These things I have spoken to you,
so that you may have peace in me.
In the world, you will have difficulties.
